limitations: The formal CI does not use the private production Image or complete native DT.
Synthetic TSENS temperature, all-channel bootstrap mask and 1 ms sampling are explicit references, not tablet measurements.
Per-device migration tests disable UFS and do not establish complete-board migration.
The separate CPU artifact and board artifact are different builds; no CPU ZIP hash is substituted for the board binary.
Full native-DT userspace, Android, GPU/NPU execution and native SMMU DMA remain unpassed; see native-52492a.json.
